utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody in the courtroom. Our apologies for the delayed start. We were occupied by some other matters which had to be resolved first. Before we start with the next witness, I would like to raise one matter. It has come to the attention of the Chamber that several documents that were admitted through Witness Stefanie Frease on the 10th of September, 2010, are still missing their respective translations. These documents are P814, P388, P862, and P770. Does the Prosecution have any update on the above exhibits? Mr. Vanderpuye.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Good afternoon to you, Your Honours. We have been in contact with the Registry regarding these matters and we are in the process of getting translations of the relevant documents. I would point out that P388 is an entire notebook, which generally we've not translated the entire notebook. I'll have to go back perhaps and look in the record and see the circumstances under which it was admitted so we can identify the relevant portions to be translated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The Chamber would like to ask the Registry to convert the four documents I mentioned back to the MFI status pending translation, and then you may request specific parts of that document to be admitted into evidence. Lastly, the Chamber suggests dealing with any outstanding matters in relation to those exhibits and any others towards the end of the Prosecution case, at which point the Chamber should and will reserve some time to discuss the pending admission of a number of exhibits during a housekeeping session. Are there any other matters to be discussed before we hear the witness? This is not the case. The next witness will be heard in closed session. He was granted protective measures. We move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honours. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The Chamber has heard a witness in closed session as a protective measure today. We adjourn now and resume tomorrow in the afternoon, 2.15, in Courtroom III. We adjourn.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 21st day of June, 2011, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.04 p.m.,
